sections.title: The Six Trigonometric Ratios: Sine, Cosine, Tangent and Their Reciprocals
learning_goals: Define sine, cosine, and tangent in terms of opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse sides of a right triangle.
Identify the reciprocal relationships between sine/cosecant, cosine/secant, and tangent/cotangent.
Recall the formulas for all six trigonometric ratios.

learning_goals: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find missing side lengths in a right triangle.
